subject: SOC 2 recertification — evidence orbit sprint and capacity onramp
messages:
From: Lynn Porter <lynn@brightaudit.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>; Devon Chen <devon@zenithpayments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 recert — evidence scope and retention ask

Hi Karthik / Devon,

Thanks again for the quick sync this morning. To move the recertification forward on our side we need the following by Apr 15 so we can include it in the audit package:

- 90 → 365 day log retention confirmation for auth/transaction logs (or an export policy that guarantees 365d retention)
- A primary inventory CSV mapping of evidence owners + delivery lanes (ACL, logs, config snapshots)
- Sample log extracts for a rolling week (we can accept zipped JSON)

We understand you mentioned an upcoming capacity change — if Redwood will need to stage a bulk export we should plan for a short burst window and a mutually agreed transfer SLA. We can coordinate with your ops team for a scheduled window to minimize impact.

If there are commercial implications (term addendum, seat uplift, or temporary burst credits) flag them and we can loop procurement.

Attached: evidence-request-template.csv

Best,
Lynn

Lynn Porter
Senior Auditor, BrightAudit
lynne.porter@brightaudit.com

---
Attachment: evidence-request-template.csv (csv stub, 2kb)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Lynn Porter <lynn@brightaudit.com>, Devon Chen <devon@zenithpayments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 recert — evidence scope and retention ask

Lynn — thanks, this is clear. Quick plan from our side: 

1) Retention: We can guarantee 365d retention for auth and transaction logs in the US region via our retention policy. That will require a short-term configuration change and a small storage uplift. We can provide a contract addendum to reflect the retention horizon for recertification.

2) Inventory CSV: Attached "soc2-evidence-inventory.csv" — maps evidence owners and delivery lanes. Laura will own the inventory and delivery pacing.

3) Bulk export window: We propose a scheduled staging window on Apr 20 (02:00–06:00 PT) to run the export. We expect a burst of ~1.2 TB compressed; ops will provision a burst queue and we will throttle to keep latency impact below your stated SLA. If Zenith needs additional throughput we can propose a temporary seat/throughput uplift.

Commercials: For the 365d retention and the burst export we recommend a capacity addendum: one-month burst credit (waived for renewal customers) or a one-time export fee. Marissa — can you confirm pricing options and confirm whether we can offer a credit vs fee?

I'll attach a short mutual action plan and the log sample reference.

Thanks,
Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Head of Customer Solutions, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai

---
Attachment: soc2-evidence-inventory.csv (csv stub, 12kb)
Attachment: log-sample-90d.json (zip stub, 45kb)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Lynn Porter <lynn@brightaudit.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Devon Chen <devon@zenithpayments.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Apr 2027 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 recert — evidence scope and retention ask

Karthik / Lynn — pricing and procurement note here. We can absorb the one-month burst credit for the export as a goodwill gesture tied to Zenith's upcoming renewal / expansion (their renewal is up in June). For the 365d retention change we propose a term amendment for the next 12 months to cover the marginal storage delta.

Options: 
- Option A (preferred): Waive burst export fee; add a 12-month retention addendum at listed incremental storage rate (we'll discount 20% for renewal customers).
- Option B: One-time export fee (covers ops provisioning) and no term amendment.

I'll prepare a short SOW addendum and a DocuSign link; Devon / Zenith: please confirm which option aligns with your procurement runway. If Zenith is interested in committing to a small seat uplift (equivalent of 2 reserved GPU seats) we can include the retention addendum at no incremental charge for the first 6 months.

Marissa
VP Growth, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

---
Attachment: evidence-orbit-plan-v1.pdf (pdf stub, 85kb)
From: Devon Chen <devon@zenithpayments.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lynn Porter <lynn@brightaudit.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 6 Apr 2027 11:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 recert — evidence scope and retention ask

Thanks all — Zenith prefers Option A. We will: 
- Accept a 12-month retention addendum (signed with the renewal) and appreciate the 20% renewal discount.
- Confirm the Apr 20 window for the bulk export. Ops will provide a dedicated SFTP endpoint and a contact (Samir) for the transfer.
- Regarding seat uplift: Procurement is evaluating the temporary 2-seat commitment; we should know by Apr 12. If we commit we expect the retention addendum to carry at no charge for the first 6 months as described.

Please send the DocuSign link and the amended retention clause so legal can review with procurement.

Devon
Senior Security Program Manager, Zenith Payments
devon@zenithpayments.com
